newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end choppy day lower.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end choppy day lower.

text.p: June 25 - U.S. stock index futures closed mostly lower on the PSA's forecasts for higher U.S. rates by the end of 1997. Sept S&Ps reversed gains in fast trade and fell 15 pts, the initial daily limit, to 890.00. Rubin's comments, and the sale of $1 bln cash 10-yr notes, also weighed on S&Ps, traders said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
